notes.title: Patch Note #2 - 3rd Closed Beta
notes.notes:
New patch alert!

[h3]PATCH NOTE #2[/h3]
3rd Closed Beta 
[b]0.2407.9 - July 12th[/b]

🐛 Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Changed the sponsor rewards mechanic so you won't receive them when its the end of a match
[*] Added [TAB] in scoreboard to display more information on sponsor and opponent's tactics
[*] Added the possibility to go back to a previous step in Bootcamp
[*] Tweaked copy for "Wanted" tooltip
[*] Tweaked copy in Bootcamp where it said "Hover over the Mouth" instead of "Mouse"
[*] Added more size options to the Event Log. Now when you select a size, it'll remain that size for future games
[*] Updated French translations in Bootcamp
[*] Added an option to always show Skill Rolls. You can also Hold ALT during a skill execution to show the roll.
[/list]

Please restart your game to get the new fixes!

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Don't be scared by the seemingly big block of text, all is well! In fact, it has been an incredible 2024 for the Blindspot team - we've announced our game, attended PAX and Demo Night, hosted an alpha playtest, soon followed by two awesome, closed beta playtests.  

With the growth of our game's audience, and the amount of feedback we have been so lucky to receive, we've come to the conclusion that we will need to push the date of our Early Access release to early 2025. When we initially picked our date, we couldn't have known we'd get such thoughtful and thorough suggestions from all of you. Knowing what we know now and having looked over the survey results and Discord suggestions, we'd like to do right by all of you and take the appropriate time and steps to make our game as kick-ass as possible. 

We hope you'll stay tuned to what our team will bring next, as its sure to include more playtests, where your thoughts and feedback will be a necessity.  

Thank you once again for an incredible year so far, we hope to keep bringing you hexa-joy. 

-Blindspot Games Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39892952/e268567a7725b078e8dccc87b9d14a1a9da59db2.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Note #3 - Closed Beta
notes.notes:
Closed Beta Patch Note
[b]0.2404.9[/b] – April 8th 

📖 [b]Onboarding[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Bonus Effect text in Tutorial.
[/list]

🎲 [b]Gameplay fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed too many kills awarded on some occasions (Parvati's ultimate, Lunah's attack switch).
[*]Fixed Frostbite being applied to too many targets in some specific situations.
[*]Fixed AI stuck on some occasions, when Mushashi displaces himself after dealing damage during his Overwatch.
[*]Tactic Stick to the Plan can't target KO'd Champions anymore.
[*]Added more time before AI chooses a sponsor reward.
[/list]

🖱️[b]Mouse control[/b]
[list]
[*]Camera rotation and movement with mouse will now keep the cursor at the current position in the screen. 
[*]Reduced Right click long press time from 1s -> 0.2s to trigger mouse camera movement.
[/list]

🎶 [b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed crowd and announcer audio mix.
[/list]

🐛 [b]Other Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Typos in Hit Point tooltip.
[*]Added missing names for Lorolocco and Pharmacomp Sponsors (displayed in event log after sponsor reward has been chosen).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note #1 - Closed Beta
notes.notes:
Closed Beta Patch Note
[b]0.2404.5-Prod[/b] – April 5th 

📖 [b]Onboarding[/b]

[list]
[*]The cheer bar is now visible in the Advanced Tutorial module about Upgrades. 
[*]The Overwatch tutorial has been tweaked
[*]The copy in the Champions’ Challenges has been changed.
[*]Laxmee’s challenge victory condition has changed: she now needs to be in the scoring zone AND stay alive.
[/list]

🎲 [b]Gameplay fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed Hannibal having a teammate play an action while being in Overwatch. Overwatch is now correctly cancelled. 
[*]Fixed displacing drop on a champion not triggering the drop.
[*]Fixed Player stuck in Combat UI when chaining a move and an action request and failing to disengage on their way.
[*]TACTIC: Fixed Dance for me Tactic not allowing to target Champions.
[*]TACTIC: Parvati’s Advanced Surgery now Hastens its target 3 times
[*]TACTIC: Hannibal's Code<Audible>'s feedback in Timeline is now fixed.
[*]TACTIC: Fixed Tactic Adamantine so it can't target Valkyrie or other Immovable Champions.
[*]TACTIC: Code:<Dive> - Fixed Champion not able to attack if he attacked during his last turn
[/list]

🌐 [b]Online matchmaking[/b]

[list]
[*]Match intro now displays the name of your opponent instead of a Worthy Opponent (not that they are not).
[*]Stability fixes for online matches.
[*]Reduced opponent disconnected timeout from 60s to 20s.
[*]Shows a “player disconnected” popup while in pick and ban if opponent encountered connection issues.
[/list]

🎨 [b]Animations[/b]

[list]
[*]Updated Gata's ultimate animation “Like a cheetah” 
[/list]

🎶 [b]Sound[/b]

[list]
[*]Removed some voices still attributed to Gata and 8-Ball.
[/list]

🐛 [b]Other Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed double escape at the end of the game closing and opening the menu back.
[*]Fixed unable to escape if pause menu is displaying before entering the game during the cinematic.
[*]Fixed feedback panel not available in gameplay with f11 shortcut.
[/list]
